references.text: The Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the testimony, so that wrath may not come upon the congregation of the people of Israel. The Levites shall have charge of the tabernacle of the testimony.
You shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out their priestly service. But any outsider who comes near shall be put to death.

Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the tabernacle, on the east side. They were to keep watch over the sanctuary on behalf of the people of Israel. Any outsider who came near was to be put to death.
Describes the duties of the Levites in packing up and carrying the articles of the sanctuary when the camp was to break journey.
The priestly service is given as a gift, and any outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
A reminder to the people of Israel that no outsider, not of Aaron's line, may come near to burn incense before the face of the Lord.
Describes the setting up of the tabernacle, which the Levites were later given responsibility for.
The tribe of Levi was chosen to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord and to stand before the face of the Lord to serve him.
